rounds.text: Despite reported top-line expansion, the business suffers from severe operational cash generation failures, posting a negative operating and free cash flow of Rs -739 Cr in March 2026, which translates to a catastrophic cash conversion of -18.48x and -1,861% of operating profit [E34, E35, E36, E37]. Conceded: compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months is 78%, and operating margins have increased over the last four years [E17, E32].
